science.label: Elevation
science.title: Color shows height above the source's 470 km reference sphere; brightness shows terrain relief under fixed northwest lighting. Polar caps beyond 60° latitude are withheld because the published model interpolates polar gaps without a validity mask. Gray grid marks withheld or missing data.

science.label: Clay band
science.description: Dawn VIR 2.7 µm band depth · scale from its own range
science.title: Depth of the 2.7 µm absorption of OH in Mg-rich clays (phyllosilicates), from the archived Dawn VIR global mosaic (Survey phase, public V2 calibration). The color scale spans this map's own 2nd to 98th percentile, 0.229 to 0.283, with the rainbow core of the Frigeri et al. (2019), Figure 7 bar (its colors between the dark blue and dark red ends). The archived values are deeper than that paper's (median 0.255 against its peak near 0.20): the paper used an artifact correction and instrument response (Carrozzo et al. 2016) that were never released, and a different continuum. Scan stripes remain for the same reason. Gray grid: beyond 60° latitude and other unmeasured pixels.

science.label: Ammonium band
science.description: Dawn VIR 3.1 µm band depth · scale from its own range
science.title: Depth of the 3.1 µm absorption of ammonium (NH4) in clays, from the archived Dawn VIR global mosaic (Survey phase, public V2 calibration). The color scale spans this map's own 2nd to 98th percentile, 0.047 to 0.089, with the rainbow core of the Frigeri et al. (2019), Figure 7 bar (its colors between the dark blue and dark red ends). The archived values are shallower than that paper's (median 0.064 against its peak near 0.09): the paper used an artifact correction and instrument response (Carrozzo et al. 2016) that were never released, and a different continuum. Scan stripes remain for the same reason. Gray grid: beyond 60° latitude and other unmeasured pixels.

sources.label: Monochrome
sources.coverage: Dawn FC2 body-fixed orthorectified global mosaic. The PDS bundle-block adjustment uses Dawn orbit/attitude and the high-resolution Ceres shape model for ray intersections; the Kait-anchored longitude system is shared with the Dawn shape/topography work. Observed pixels, shadows, and mosaic seams are preserved. Exactly black pixels connected to the southern source border are marked with the shared neutral gray cartographic grid before reprojection. No inferred terrain or inpainting; the extreme south pole and other source gaps remain missing.
